finding: With Rule-21.1-grounded costs, the substrate's REAL metabolism is ~1532 measured native cycles/tick (dominated by the 857-cycle CAM Hamming read), ~10x the old invented figure. Income is 256 cycles per fully-resolved cell (CELL_STATES=2^8, hardware-derived). The seeded ancestor still earns ZERO income (it cannot read correctly), so it starves at tick 163. Break-even requires resolving ~6 cells/tick. This confirms the metabolic-ceiling finding with real measurement: the current architecture cannot sustain itself on honest metabolism — the bottleneck is compositional reading ability, not a tunable cost constant.
